title: This Free App Just Replaced Paid AI Voice Tools
sources: github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio README and repo stats, checked 2026-11-17

lines.text: This free app can clone voices, dub videos, and narrate audiobooks.
And it runs on your own computer.
Over one hundred and twelve thousand stars on GitHub, in about seven months.
lines.caps: OVER *112,000 | STARS ON *GITHUB | IN ABOUT *7 MONTHS

lines.text: Clone a voice from a clean recording.
Describe a voice in words, and it builds it for you.
Dub whole videos into other languages, timed to the original.
lines.caps: *DUB WHOLE VIDEOS | INTO OTHER *LANGUAGES | *TIMED TO THE ORIGINAL

lines.text: Dictate, transcribe, and narrate full audiobooks.
No account. No subscription. Everything runs on your own hardware.
Mac, Windows, Linux, and even phones.
One rule: only clone voices you have permission to use.
Save this before you forget, and comment which free AI tool I should reveal next!
